data.gender_notes: Nikolaus is used as a male name in Christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Greek word nikos (victory) and laos (people). The name Nikolaus signifies the victory of the people in various contexts. The name Nikolaus carries the meaning “Victory of the people” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Nikolaus usually hope their child will grow to embody victory of the people and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A symbol of hope and triumph over adversity.
data.etymology: Nikolaus belongs to the Biblical linguistic tradition and is used in Christian naming. Its recorded meaning is “Victory of the people.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Nikolaus total 3, giving a life-path number of 3. Number 3 is linked with Jupiter and with the qualities of creativity, expression and optimism.

in_hebrew.name: ניקולאוס
in_hebrew.long_meaning: השם ניקולאוס מקורו במילים היווניות 'ניקוס' (נצחון) ו'לאוס' (עם), ומשמעותו 'נצחון העם' או 'תש victory לעם'. השם ניקולאוס קשור לנצחון הרוחני ולגבורת האמונה הנוצרית.

in_greek.name: Νικόλαος
in_greek.long_meaning: Το όνομα Νικόλαος προέρχεται από τις ελληνικές λέξεις 'νίκη' (νίκη) και 'λαός' (λαός), που σημαίνει 'νίκη του λαού' ή 'θρίαμβος του λαού'. Στην παράδοση Χριστιανική, ο Νικόλαος είναι γνωστός ως προστάτης των ναυτικών και των παιδιών.

in_latin.name: Nicolaus
in_latin.long_meaning: The name Nicolaus is derived from the Greek words 'nike' (victory) and 'laos' (people), signifying 'victory of the people' or 'triumph of the people'. In Christian tradition, Saint Nicholas is revered as a protector of sailors and children, embodying spiritual victory and faith.

in_english.name: Nikolaus
in_english.meaning: victory of the people or triumph of the people
in_english.long_meaning: The name Nikolaus originates from the Greek words 'nike' (victory) and 'laos' (people), meaning 'victory of the people' or 'triumph of the people'. It is associated with Saint Nicholas, a 4th-century bishop of Myra, known for his generosity and kindness, especially towards children. The name symbolizes spiritual victory, faith, and protection.

data.cultural_impact: St. Nicolas is one of the most revered saints in Christian traditions worldwide. He is known for his numerous acts of kindness, generosity and miracles. Saint Nikolaus is often depicted as a bishop and is associated with gift-giving, especially at Christmas time. The legend of St. Nikolaus putting gold coins into the shoes of poor children has evolved into the modern tradition of Santa Claus.
data.spiritual_significance: The name Nikolaus carries a deep spiritual significance as it is inspired by the early Christian saint, who was known for his faithfulness, courage, and charitable works. St. Nikolaus' greatest virtue was his love for the poor and needy. His life story serves as a reminder of the importance of generosity, compassion, and kindness in our own lives, inspiring us to become beacons of hope and love for those in need. Therefore, thename Nikolaus embodies the spirit of love, generosity, and victory over hardship.
